decisions.reason: Moving navigation links to the footer does not change the website's dark, non-switchable page theme.
The candidate already has a same-message Event establishing that the header menu is disabled; the footer-link decision requires no additional update to its state.
The source concerns navigation placement on the public website, not the distinct footer or side navigation within the admin workspace shell.
Footer navigation placement does not alter the required color, typography, spacing, radius, or border token specifications.
The source does not change the landing-page section order, How It Works content, or other recorded content structure.
The navigation-placement decision establishes no change to reusable responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance.
Adding navigation links to the footer does not change the selected plain HTML and Tailwind CSS build stack.
The footer-navigation clause is independent of the same message's requirement for LumenArc branding on the Cognito sign-in page.
The source specifies where navigation links belong but does not modify the landing page's responsive-layout requirement.
Footer navigation placement does not change the requirement for a landing-page sign-up button.
The navigation decision is owned by the website header and footer Requirements and does not change the landing page's recorded colors, typography, concepts, or logo-treatment ambiguity.
Footer navigation placement does not change how text is emphasized in the landing-page hero.
